mechanism_claims.assay: cryo-EM structural evidence plus peptide sequence panel

mechanism_claims.assay_type: cryo-EM structural evidence plus peptide sequence panel
mechanism_claims.claim_text: The N-terminally extended HR2 peptide binds the HR1HR2 bundle in an extended conformation and adds HR1 contacts relative to shorter HR2 peptides.
mechanism_claims.evidence_assay: cryo-EM structural evidence plus peptide sequence panel
mechanism_claims.limitations: Cryo-EM structural binding evidence supports HR1/HR2 engagement and is not labeled direct_mechanism because it is not an activity assay endpoint.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: N-terminal HR2 extension increases inhibition of SARS-CoV-2 spike-mediated cell-cell fusion, with longHR2_42/45 near 1 nM and shortHR2 around 263 nM.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Functional fusion inhibition does not by itself prove a unique molecular intermediate beyond the HR1/HR2 binding model.

mechanism_claims.assay: VSV-SARS-CoV-2 and authentic SARS-CoV-2 infection assays plus washout experiment
mechanism_claims.assay_or_evidence_type: VSV-SARS-CoV-2 and authentic SARS-CoV-2 infection assays plus washout experiment
mechanism_claims.assay_type: VSV-SARS-CoV-2 and authentic SARS-CoV-2 infection assays plus washout experiment
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Virus infection and washout assays support durable inhibition of SARS-CoV-2 entry by targeting the spike prehairpin fusion intermediate.
mechanism_claims.evidence_assay: VSV-SARS-CoV-2 and authentic SARS-CoV-2 infection assays plus washout experiment
mechanism_claims.limitations: Classified as supported inference because the infection assays measure antiviral effect and washout behavior, not direct visualization of every inhibited prehairpin intermediate.
